benefits: Coverage: The loan covers your tuition and other school fees.

Rate: 4% per year.
When It Begins:
After Graduation: Interest starts two years after you finish your studies.
If You Don’t Graduate: Interest starts two years after your last loan if you haven’t completed your course.
Interest Calculation: Interest is calculated using the formula: Interest = Loan Amount x 4% x Time (using the Diminishing Method).
No Interest: If you repay the loan in full within two years after graduation, you won’t pay any interest.

Cash
Manager’s Check
Postal Money Order (PMO)
Deposit into a CHED-LBP account

Repayment Formula: Total Repayment = Loan Amount + Interest.

Additional Interest of 2% per year.
A surcharge of 2% of the total balance.
How to Pay: CHEDRO will send you a bill. Payments can be made directly to CHEDRO, CHED Central Office, or a Land Bank account.
Alternative Payments: Services provided to government agencies may be considered as repayment.
